authorization: Maintainer: Keep and Optimize for 1 writer; additionally requested 16-writer coverage.
hypothesis: The whole-extent serial fallback avoids background work but adds a full 1MiB first-allocation stall to a concurrent wave. Retain the original bounded 128KiB demand prefix for every write; only request asynchronous suffix work when multiple batch operations are outstanding.
candidate: Remove the whole-extent early return from the failed serial prototype. Compute the current 128KiB-aligned required prefix through the original shared cursor, and send a background target only if the reservation owner reports more than one outstanding operation. A stale concurrency observation affects scheduling only. Do not change DATA/FRONTIER ordering, allocated targets, sync protocol, hashes or resource charges.
protocol: SSD only; same 1KiB values,2GiB SST,parallel mode and explicit formats. One warmup per arm. Alternate arm order between pairs. 30s initial cooldown and 10s between runs. Host auditing before/during(1Hz)/after, no build/test/profile overlap, all stalls retained. Run 16-writer cells first, then serial and eight-writer cells. No retries chosen by score.
guards: Each cell candidate/async paired raw, v4-normalized and arm-median throughput >=0.95, paired p99<=1.10, identical DATA bytes and paired sync count<=1.05. Serial additionally requires p99 versus async<=0.95 and versus pre-async<=1.10; paired raw versus pre-async>=0.95. CPU reported. These are exploratory fix guards, not complete RFC qualification. Report exact failed guards without overriding the maintainer retention of the original async optimization.
correctness: Full cargo make check and direct typos outside sandbox. Keep concurrent-producer reservation fixtures. Serial and concurrent-to-serial rollover test must recover every ACK while showing no new background target, no suffix overwrite and demand readiness rounded to 128KiB rather than the complete allocated extent.
decision: Keep the maintainer-retained async core. Keep this revised scheduling fix only if the fixed five-cell SSD matrix passes. Preserve the first serial prototype, its failed 16-writer p99 guard and all completed captures; cancel its unrun cells after completing requested 16-writer coverage. Do not pool different candidate binaries or select runs by score. No PR or push.
